reason: As someone who has already quit a meal delivery service and two apps, Document B wins me over by answering my practical questions—like being able to swap meals, skip weeks, or cancel anytime—and by introducing a real named dietitian I can actually talk to for 15 minutes before spending money. Both documents are refreshingly honest about the small A1C sample size, though Document A also slightly misstates the facts by implying the 0.6-point average drop was only among the 10 people whose numbers went down rather than across all 14.
